text: Dopamine is a chemical messenger in your brain, called a neurotransmitter.
It is often called the pleasure chemical, but that is not the full story.
Dopamine is mostly about wanting and motivation. It pushes you to go after a reward.
It spikes when you expect something good, like a notification, a snack, or a win.
That is why scrolling and games are so hard to stop. Your brain keeps chasing the next reward.
Dopamine also helps with focus, learning, and movement. Low levels in some brain areas are linked to Parkinson's disease.
You can support healthy dopamine with good sleep, exercise, sunlight, and small goals you actually finish.
